scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crewops/shared && npm run build -w @crewops/db && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @crewops/api" "npm run dev -w @crewops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crewops/shared && npm run build -w @crewops/db && npm run build -w @crewops/api && npm run build -w @crewops/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/*/.next .turbo && find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @crewops/shared && npm run build -w @crewops/db && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
